ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: image1 shows a circle with nine points labeled 1 to 9, and the points are arranged in circular order; the line segments 1–3 and 3–5 have already been drawn in the figure. image2 gives five candidate figures (A) to (E), each of which has several connecting lines drawn on a nine-point circle with the same numbering. Reasoning: The rule of the problem is to connect each time to the “next but one apart” point, that is, to skip one point from the current point along the numbering order and connect. Given 1→3 and 3→5, continuing gives 5→7 and 7→9. After reaching 9, continue according to the circular numbering, skip 1 to 2, so 9→2; then continue with 2→4, 4→6, 6→8, 8→1, returning to point 1. The complete connecting lines are: 1–3, 3–5, 5–7, 7–9, 9–2, 2–4, 4–6, 6–8, 8–1. Comparing with the options in image2, only (E) contains these nine connecting lines at the same time.

method.method_draft: Recognize the construction as a regular skip-2 star polygon on 9 labeled points. From the image, observe that the answer choices are different chord patterns on the same 9-point circle. From the text, the operation is always a jump of two labels around the circle, i.e. add 2 modulo 9. Since gcd(9,2)=1, this single jump cycle visits all 9 points before returning to 1, forming the star polygon {9/2}. In image2, identify the option that shows this full skip-2 star using all nine points; that drawing is (E).
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：image1 中有一个圆，圆周上标了 1 到 9 九个点，并且已经画出了从 1 到 3、从 3 到 5 的弦。image2 中给出五个选项 A 到 E，都是同一类 9 点圆上的不同连线图案；其中选项 E 显示了依次连接 1-3、3-5、5-7、7-9、9-2、2-4、4-6、6-8、8-1 的完整交错星形连线。
推理：题目要求“总是连接到隔一个点的下一个点”，也就是每次编号加 2，并按 9 取模。从 1 开始得到序列 1→3→5→7→9→2→4→6→8→1。因为 gcd(9,2)=1，所以会经过全部 9 个点后才回到 1，形成 9 点的跳 2 星形多边形 {9/2}。与 image2 中的选项比较，完整显示这个跳 2 星形的是选项 E。
